messages:
Maya: Thinking out loud — proposal to recluster the left rail: group Models + Datasets + Embeddings under a single 'Assets' section to reduce visual noise. Concern: how do we handle existing permalinks and keyboard traversal?

Omar: I like the cluster. Permalinks are the big risk. We should preserve legacy routes for at least 6 months via redirects. Example: `/models` -> `/assets/models`. Also make sure keyboard focus doesn't jump when a redirect happens.

Maya: Agreed on redirect timeline. Plan sketch: accept legacy path, show canonical `/assets/...` in the address bar, and keep focus in-place. @Kevin any infra constraints for a redirect table?

Kevin: Ops-wise we prefer client-side rewrite if possible — avoids infra migration. Simple client router rule could do it: `if (path.startsWith('/models')) history.replaceState(null, '', '/assets/models')` then render. That keeps history clean.

Omar: Quick code note (rough):
```js
// on app boot
router.beforeEach((to, from, next) => {
  if (to.path === '/models') {
    next({ path: '/assets/models', replace: true })
  } else next()
})
```
This should preserve back button behavior.

Eli: A11y requirements: keyboard users must not lose their skiplink context when routes change. If we rename anchors, ensure `Skip to content` still lands inside the active workspace and the element receives focus. Also add `aria-current=\"page\"` on the active subgroup item and role=navigation on breadcrumbs.

Maya: Good point. Also thinking about scroll preservation between sibling clusters — users often jump between two models and expect the left rail to keep scroll. Proposal: maintain per-route scroll offset in the router state or use `history.scrollRestoration = 'manual'`.

Omar: I vote for storing offset in a small client store keyed by route. `history.scrollRestoration` is browser-level and flaky across SPA navigations. We'll save/restore on `beforeRouteLeave`/`beforeRouteEnter`.

Lina: From research: people expect permalinks to capture panel state (open side pane, filters). Two patterns: long query params `?panel=insights&filters=owner:me` which are copyable but verbose, or short shortlinks `/p/abcd12` that expand server-side. Users prefer readable, shareable links that open exactly the same UI.

Maya: Shortlinks are ideal but require backend. For initial rollout we could use hash-fragment encoding like `#/assets/models?panel=insights&f=owner:me` so server stays agnostic and permalinks still restore state client-side. Thoughts on tradeoffs?

Kevin: Shortlink service needs DB + auth checks — nontrivial for early stage. Hash fragments are fastest to ship and won't hit the server, but they don't play nicely with crawlers (not a priority). I'll scope infra work: shortlink service vs documented hash approach.

Eli: Accessibility nit on fragments: when loading a permalink with a fragment/state, make sure we programmatically set initial focus to the panel heading `panelHeading.focus({preventScroll: true})` so screen reader users land in context. Also announce via polite live region if content changed.

Maya: Copy question: should the left rail group be 'Assets' or 'Resources'? Lina?

Lina: 'Assets' is clearer for models/datasets/embeddings. 'Resources' felt too generic in testing. Recommend 'Assets' + microcopy tooltip: \"Models, datasets, and embeddings\".

Omar: Breadcrumbs: prefer `Workspace > Asset type > Asset name`. Right now we collapse long names earlier — prefer full name with CSS ellipsis and `title` attribute for hover. Also breadcrumb links should be deep links to the exact filtered list (not just the list root).

Maya: Action items I captured: 1) Omar: implement client-side redirects + per-route scroll preservation prototype. 2) Eli: add `aria-current` to subgroup items, ensure skiplink lands properly and initial focus on permalink load. 3) Kevin: compare shortlink infra vs hash-fragment approach and estimate effort. 4) Lina: finalize copy 'Assets' + tooltip microcopy. I'll create tickets and a short rollout plan.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: D-4217 — \"Left rail regroup + permalinks & a11y\" (assignee: Maya). :white_check_mark:

Maya: thanks all — I'll post a short mockup update in the channel later this afternoon and tag folks for review.
